home.title: Funny One
home.subtitle: Pass the device and build absurd stories together, 2 to 7 players, no internet needed.
home.rules: Pass the device around. Each round, everyone answers the same playful question in turn. Your answers get mixed into absurd stories, then a silly picture is built for each one.
home.picturesBuiltInHint: Drawn on this device. No Internet needed.
home.picturesOnlineHint: Cartoons from the picture library. Needs the Internet; without it you get the built-in pictures.

handoff.title: Pass to {{name}}
handoff.subtitle: Don't peek at anyone else's answers.

footer.contentNotice: This game runs entirely on your device. Nothing you type ever leaves it.
footer.contentNoticeOnline: Nothing you type ever leaves this device. With Internet pictures on, each story's cartoon is downloaded from the picture library.
